name: Bàscara (Spain)
description: Divided per bend sinister yellow and dark blue, with two juxtaposed bends sinister along the division, red above and white below.
history: The flag was approved on 14 April 2010 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 5620 of 3 May 2010; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, bicolour per bend sinister yellow and dark blue, with two juxtaposed bends sinister each 1/18 of the length, red above and white below, at the centre.

features.role: bend sinister 1/18 of the length above the division
